### Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace Earns One MICHELIN Star in the 2026 Southwest MICHELIN Guide


08/27/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 493 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Restaurant-Guy-Savoy-at-Caesars-Palace-Earns-One-MICHELIN-Star-in-the-2026-Southwest-MICHELIN-Guide-2026.pdf)


*Acclaimed restaurant recognized among the Southwest’s premier dining destinations*


***Photos of Restaurant Guy Savoy can be found*[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1iP4688o-Ro2tvDDyLzQWnJ5oapzuYtkb%3Fusp%3Dsharing&esheet=54595392&newsitemid=20260826187270&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=9c0e0151fd541bd644fa8cf9eee0d8d7) ****


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace has been awarded One MICHELIN Star in the first-ever Southwest edition of the MICHELIN Guide, reaffirming its position as one of the world's most celebrated culinary destinations.


For two decades, Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace has set the standard for fine dining in Las Vegas, offering guests an elevated French dining experience built around exceptional ingredients, thoughtful preparation and impeccable service. As the restaurant commemorates its 20th anniversary, it continues to stand among the world's most celebrated dining destinations.


Led by internationally renowned Chef Guy Savoy, the Caesars Palace location remains his only restaurant outside France, delivering the same uncompromising standards, meticulous attention to detail and culinary philosophy that have made his Paris restaurants globally renowned.


Among its most celebrated offerings and guest favorites are his signature creations, including the iconic Artichoke and Black Truffle Soup, served with toasted mushroom brioche and black truffle butter, and the Colors of Caviar, a multilayered dish that highlights the depth and elegance of caviar.


“In an ever-evolving and highly competitive culinary landscape, this recognition is especially meaningful,” said Chef Guy Savoy. “A MICHELIN distinction is never earned by one person alone, and for more than 20 years, I have been fortunate to work with a talented and dedicated team that strives to create memorable experiences for our guests. We are honored that MICHELIN has recognized our commitment to excellence.”


Beyond its exceptional food, Restaurant Guy Savoy offers an impressive wine list with more than 2,800 selections. The collection includes an extensive selection of French wines, including rare and older vintages carefully curated to complement the menu.


“Restaurant Guy Savoy has been an integral part of Caesars Palace’s culinary story, and the recognition from MICHELIN further cements it among the world's best dining destinations,” said Sean McBurney, Chief Commercial Officer and Regional President of Caesars Entertainment. “This distinction reflects Chef Guy Savoy's extraordinary vision and uncompromising standards that have defined the restaurant for more than two decades.”


Since opening in 2006, Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace has been honored with praise, awards and recognition from the world's finest institutions and media outlets for its unparalleled dining experience. The dining destination has recently also earned:


- Wine Spectator Grand Award
- Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Restaurant designation
- Highest-ranked Las Vegas restaurant on La Liste’s 2026 Top 1,000 Restaurants list
- AAA Five Diamond Designation every year since 2008.


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs)**


**When did Restaurant Guy Savoy open at Caesars Palace?**


The restaurant opened on May 17, 2006.


**How can guests book a reservation at Restaurant Guy Savoy?**


Guests can book a reservation on[OpenTable](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Frestaurant-guy-savoy&esheet=54595392&newsitemid=20260826187270&lan=en-US&anchor=OpenTable&index=2&md5=bbf2c7cbe03ef339874b3c8d310698ce)


**What are Restaurant Guy Savoy’s hours of operation?**


Restaurant Guy Savoy is open Tuesday through Saturday from 5 to 9 p.m.


**Where is Restaurant Guy Savoy located at Caesars Palace?**


Restaurant Guy Savoy is located on the Mezzanine level of the Augustus Tower.


**Is there a dress code at Restaurant Guy Savoy?**


Yes, guests are requested to wear business professional attire. Shorts, T-shirts, hats and open sandals are not permitted.


**Who is the General Manager at Restaurant Guy Savoy?**


Alain Alpe has served as General Manager since 2010.


**Who is the Executive Chef at Restaurant Guy Savoy?**


Chef Nicolas Costagliola has served as the Executive Chef since 2019.


**Who leads the wine program at Restaurant Guy Savoy?**


Andrew Hurley is the Wine Director at Restaurant Guy Savoy and oversees the wine program, featuring selections designed to complement the menu.


**About Caesars Palace**


Caesars Palace, the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort where every guest is treated like a Caesar, features 3,980 hotel guest rooms and[suites](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fsuites&esheet=54595392&newsitemid=20260826187270&lan=en-US&anchor=suites&index=3&md5=fdc259187755ddf28c1caeec37a08ae7) , including the redesigned 182-room[Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fnobu-caesars-palace&esheet=54595392&newsitemid=20260826187270&lan=en-US&anchor=Nobu+Hotel+Caesars+Palace&index=4&md5=30a664bc6a216dcf976f21c69df450b5) , the renovated Colosseum Tower and[THE VILLAS Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas%2Fvillas&esheet=54595392&newsitemid=20260826187270&lan=en-US&anchor=THE+VILLAS+Caesars+Palace&index=5&md5=a2d9fd980af89216c1fe0740237a66a6) , which has earned the prestigious AAA Five Diamond rating. Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The 4,300-seat Colosseum is the most celebrated venue in Las Vegas with an impressive legacy of superstar talent featured in an intimate, once-in-a-lifetime setting. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Josh Groban, Tim McGraw, Nikki Glaser and David Spade, Jerry Seinfeld and Rod Stewart. Also, the Green Fairy Garden in front of Caesars Palace hosts ABSINTHE by Spiegelworld, an adults-only circus variety show featuring a cocktail of wild and outlandish acts. The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace showcases more than 160 boutiques and restaurants. Caesars Palace is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
